---
title: "hpa_quarto"
author: "Charles robinson"
---

To calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the **forebrain** using data from the [human protein atlas](https://www.proteinatlas.org/humanproteome/brain)
```{r}
sum(180,83,57,110)
```

The total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the human forebrain is 430
```{r}
sum(109,157,31,45)
```
The total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the pig forebrain is 342

```{r}
sum(55,185,60,98)
```
The total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the mouse forebrain is 398
